text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p95 latency spike observed on host-gpu-pool-7 for model 'redwood-v2-open' starting 2145678800. Autoscaler reports increased queueing.
sam: grabbing traces now, looks like kernel-selector is flipping between int8 and fp16 frequently under short-seq workload. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 420ms.
lee: uploading a quick flamegraph and selector debug log: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/2145678901/fg.svg
lee: selector log snippet: ```KERNEL_SELECT: seq_len=16, batch_size=3 -> selected=int8_conv_v2, fallback=fp16_matmul, decision_time=8ms, switch_count=12/5m```
anya: hmm switching rate is high — probably due to our heuristic using recent average seq_len. short bursts cause churn and KV cache misses.
miguel: KV cache evictions spiked concurrently: evictions/sec ~ 480 (baseline 60). When kernels flip we also flush some per-kv alignment buffers.
sam: hypothesis: short-seq burst + noisy tenant caused small batches, selector oscillation -> increased kernel load and cache invalidations -> blocking GC-like stalls.
anya: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) temporarily pin kernel to `fp16_matmul_stable` for host-gpu-pool-7, 2) enable small-batch-warmup FF to avoid cold kernel probes, 3) apply tenant-level soft-throttle for top noisy tenant id=org-348.
emma: oncall can we run the pin and FF toggle? I can do the routing rule change and post incident updates.
miguel: commands i propose:
```
# pin kernel for pool
infractl pools update host-gpu-pool-7 --kernel-preset fp16_matmul_stable --reason "incident 2145678901 kernel flip mitigation"
# toggle feature flag
ffctl set small_batch_warmup --on --scope pool:host-gpu-pool-7 --expires 30m
# soft throttle tenant
ratectl set org-348 --rps 0.8 --mode soft --reason "noisy tenant mitigation"
```
sam: rolling the pin now (non-disruptive), doing canary to 10% of nodes first. will monitor p95 and eviction rate.
lee: added a lightweight trace hook to capture selector decisions across the canary nodes: `selector.trace=on` for those hosts.
anya: also increase KV cache grace window from 2s -> 10s for the affected pool to reduce eviction churn. Command: `kvcfg set host-gpu-pool-7 --grace-window 10s`
emma: done with routing rule change to prefer `fp16_matmul_stable` for pool 7 via runtime-router. posted a short note to status page.
sam: canary results after 3 minutes: p95 down to 160ms, evictions/sec down to 70. queue depth normalized.
miguel: good sign. keep FF on for 30m, then evaluate whether to slow selector probe rate permanently or tweak heuristic to use median seq_len over 1m window.
lee: capturing trace dump and will attach to the postmortem. minimal errors in model outputs so quality unaffected.
anya: followups: - tune selector probe cooldown (config `probe_cooldown_ms`) - evaluate KV cache alignment change impact - add regression test for short-seq churn in our perf CI
emma: thanks all — i'll keep status updates. if metrics stay stable for 45m we'll wind down canary and create a PR for the selector heuristic change. :white_check_mark:
